column1: # Hand-maintained components for the bundled-licence index.
# Consumed by the :app:generateLicenseIndex Gradle task, which writes
# One line per component, TAB-separated. '#' starts a comment; blank lines are
#   1  display name            shown in the in-app viewer
#   2  licence label           short human label, e.g. "Apache-2.0"
#   3  version                 version/revision, or "-" when not applicable
#   4  text files              comma-separated asset paths (relative to assets/),
#   5  notice file             asset path, or "-" for none
#   6  provenance              where the licence was verified from (one line)
# The task fails if any of these files does not exist, which is what keeps a
# hand-edited line from pointing at nothing.
